moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest surf and music festival, Boardmasters, takes over Newquay, Cornwall from August 5-9, featuring acts like Fatboy Slim, Lily Allen, The Kooks, and Example.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Cornwall is buzzing! Boardmasters is officially GO, with thousands descending on Watergate Bay for sun, surf, and incredible live music. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: From Fatboy Slim to Lily Allen, The Kooks to Example – the Boardmasters lineup this year is absolutely stacked! Catch all the highlights from Newquay this week.

angles.name: Local Buzz
angles.copy: Devon and Cornwall unite! Boardmasters starts tomorrow just down the road in Newquay. Get ready for five days of epic music and surf action.

moments.title: Happy Birthday John O'Callaghan!
moments.blurb: John O'Callaghan, frontman of American rock band The Maine, turns 37 today.

angles.name: The Maine frontman
angles.copy: Shout out to John O'Callaghan from The Maine, celebrating his 37th birthday today! What's your favourite track from the band?

angles.name: Alternative rock icon
angles.copy: Happy 37th to John O'Callaghan! The voice of The Maine has given us so many anthems. Crank up their tunes today!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Billy Bob Thornton!

angles.name: Hollywood & Rock Star

angles.name: Music and Film Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating Billy Bob Thornton's 71st birthday! Actor, director, and a serious musician – what's your favourite of his many talents?

angles.name: 90s Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: It's a very happy 55th birthday to the one and only Yo-Yo! A true trailblazer in hip-hop. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Queen of Rap
angles.copy: Sending birthday love to Yo-Yo today! The 'Ain't No Way' legend is 55. Relive her classic hits with us!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Geri Halliwell!

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy (early) birthday to the one and only Geri Halliwell! Still bringing the sparkle at 54. What's your favourite Geri moment?

moments.title: FA Community Shield: Arsenal vs Man City in Cardiff!
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield returns to Cardiff's Principality Stadium on Sunday, August 16th, as Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup winners Manchester City.

angles.name: Football's Curtain Raiser
angles.copy: The traditional curtain-raiser to the English football season is just around the corner! Arsenal vs Manchester City in the Community Shield on August 16th. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage! The Principality Stadium hosts the FA Community Shield on August 16th, with Arsenal facing Man City. A huge event for the capital!

angles.name: Welsh Football Fever
angles.copy: Get ready for some top-tier football in Cardiff! The Community Shield brings Arsenal and Man City to the Principality Stadium on August 16th. Excitement is building!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Build-Up!
moments.blurb: Anticipation is growing for the Reading & Leeds Festivals, taking place August 27-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: It's getting closer! Reading & Leeds Festivals are just weeks away, with a massive lineup ready to take over the bank holiday weekend. Who are you buzzing to see?

angles.name: Headliner Spotlight
angles.copy: Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine... Reading & Leeds is stacked! Get ready for the biggest festival weekend of the summer at the end of August.
